title: Phthalates in children's intimate clothing: occurrence, accumulation, source analysis, and partitioning
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1420-1433
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00888C, Paper
Zilong Yin, Lixin Wang, Anqi Zhao, Gang Wang, Qunli Zhang
Phthalic acid esters (PAEs), commonly used as plasticizers in clothing manufacturing to enhance flexibility and ductility, were investigated in six types of children's intimate apparel.
